# 区域之外的损失：在嵌套的形成区域上比较，区域越小其外越多，整体之外什么都没有；清除者每步活跃且被支持，在它与供给其资源的来源之内不关闭任何东西，从第二步起在其外关闭栖居者 / Loss beyond a region: compared over nested regions of formations, the smaller the region the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; the clearer, active and supported at every step, closes nothing within itself and the source feeding its resource, and from step two on closes the dweller beyond them

## 主张 Claim

在一个形成区域之内，水平 l 接纳水平 l′ 在那里接纳的每个形成（Web.AdmitsWithin）；在区域之外有损失（Web.LosesBeyond），是指区域外有一个形成被 l′ 接纳而不被 l 接纳。包含就是每步在整体之内的接纳（Web.includes_iff_within_whole）。在一个区域之内成立的，在它之内的每个区域之内也成立（Web.AdmitsWithin.narrow）；在一个区域之外的损失，在它之内的每个区域之外也是损失（Web.LosesBeyond.narrow）：区域越小，其外越多。整体之外什么都没有（Web.not_losesBeyond_whole），在整体之内成立的，在任何区域之外都不留下损失（Web.AdmitsWithin.not_losesBeyond）。在单个形成之内成立的，就是它自身在 l′ 接纳它之处被 l 接纳（Web.admitsWithin_self）。Clearing 中扣留清除者的部分（Clearing.clearerPart）后的水平存在（Clearing.withheld，见 four-cases-of-a-part）。区域 Clearing.alongDependence 由清除者与供给它唯一所需条件（资源）的来源组成；它与 Clearing.fedBy_source 沿供给找到的形成一致（逐项对照，不是定理）。每步清除者都活跃且被支持，并且在这个区域之内，有它的水平接纳无它的水平所接纳的每个形成；从第二步起，在区域之外，栖居者无它时被接纳而有它时不被接纳（Clearing.loses_beyond）。所以一个部分可以每步都延续、在其依存之内不关闭任何东西，同时关闭其依存之外的东西；以整体为区域时，没有之外的损失可言（Web.not_losesBeyond_whole）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Within a region of formations, levels l admit every formation the levels l′ admit there (Web.AdmitsWithin); there is loss beyond the region (Web.LosesBeyond) when some formation outside it is admitted by l′ and not by l. Inclusion is admission within the whole at every step (Web.includes_iff_within_whole). What holds within a region holds within every region inside it (Web.AdmitsWithin.narrow); what is lost beyond a region is lost beyond every region inside it (Web.LosesBeyond.narrow): the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it. Nothing lies beyond the whole (Web.not_losesBeyond_whole), and what holds within the whole leaves nothing lost beyond any region (Web.AdmitsWithin.not_losesBeyond). Within one formation, what holds is its own admission by l wherever l′ admits it (Web.admitsWithin_self). In Clearing the levels without the clearer's part (Clearing.clearerPart) exist (Clearing.withheld, see four-cases-of-a-part). The region Clearing.alongDependence is the clearer with the source that feeds the one condition it requires, its resource; it matches the formations Clearing.fedBy_source finds along feeding (checked by inspection, not by a theorem). At every step the clearer is active and supported, and within this region the levels with its part admit every formation the levels without it admit; from step two on, beyond the region, the dweller is admitted without the clearer's part and not with it (Clearing.loses_beyond). So a part can continue at every step and close nothing within its dependence while closing what lies beyond it; with the whole as the region there is no loss beyond to speak of (Web.not_losesBeyond_whole). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Regions.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regions.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 形成的区域是陈述的参数（形成上的谓词）；整体是网中全部形成的区域，即所表示的整体。 / Regions of formations are parameters of the statement (predicates on formations); the whole is the region of all formations of the web, the represented whole.
- Clearing 的结论：平衡；清除者只依存于其资源；扣留清除者的部分后的水平从同一起点（Clearing.withheld）。 / For the Clearing results: balance; the clearer depends only on its resource; the levels without the clearer's part from the same start (Clearing.withheld).
- 比较在每一步上，并保持其余交换不变。 / The comparison is at each step and holds the rest of the exchange fixed.
- 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 关于层级写道：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self. not saying this is what life does, but what's good for being generative, and the self is a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”。作者先前说只有不退化的动力学能无限延续，并在对话中更正：这对整体与形成自身的条件成立，对每个部分不成立，搭便车者是反例。Clearing.loses_beyond 就是这个反例的形式：清除者在其依存之内一直延续，在其外关闭栖居者。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：形成的区域读作自身、所在的系统与整体；区域越小其外越多，给出 Ren 的次序——整体、系统、自身——按判据的强弱排列，不加公理；整体之外什么都没有，所以对整体，延续与不退化重合。这里的整体是一个网中全部形成的区域；按 Ren 确认的第二项读法，实际的整体从不是任何中心对它的模型，从不被完全表示。读法与名称是 AI 的。 / Of levels Ren wrote: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self. not saying this is what life does, but what's good for being generative, and the self is a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”. The author had said that only dynamics that do not degenerate can continue indefinitely, and corrected this in the conversation: it holds for the whole and for a formation's own conditions, not for every part, with a free rider as the counterexample. Clearing.loses_beyond is that counterexample in form: the clearer continues within its dependence and closes the dweller beyond it. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): regions of formations read as the self, the system one is in and the whole; that the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it gives Ren's order, whole, system, self, as an order of the criteria by strength, with no axiom; nothing lies beyond the whole, so for the whole continuing and not degenerating coincide. The whole here is the region of all formations of a web; by Ren's second confirmed reading the actual whole is never any center's model of it and is never fully represented. The reading and the names are the AI's.
